description_en: Uses a registered managed credential to proxy access to the native ES API. The accessible scope is determined by the permissions of the credential on the ES side. When calling this operation through a RAM user with a managed credential, the caller must have both the permission for this operation and the elasticsearch:UseCredential permission for the credential being used
description_zh: 使用已登记的托管凭证代理访问 ES 原生 API，可访问范围由该凭证在 ES 侧的权限决定。另外，通过子账号以及托管凭证访问此接口时调用方除需具备本接口权限外，还需对所使用的凭证具备 elasticsearch:UseCredential 权限
name: InvokeEsRequest

parameters.help_en: The ES path to access. This parameter is required. The leading / can be omitted
parameters.help_zh: 要访问的 ES 路径，必填；开头的 / 可省略
parameters.name: path

parameters.help_en: The HTTP method used to access ES. Default value: GET
parameters.help_zh: 访问 ES 时使用的 HTTP 方法，默认 GET
parameters.name: method

parameters.help_en: The ID of the credential to use. If this parameter is not specified, the default credential of the instance is used
parameters.help_zh: 指定使用的凭证 ID，不传则使用该实例的默认凭证
parameters.name: credential_id

parameters.help_en: The request body passed through to ES. Set this parameter based on the requirements of the target ES API. This parameter is not required for calls such as GET that do not have a request body
parameters.help_zh: 透传给 ES 的请求体，按目标 ES 接口的要求填写；GET 等无请求体的调用可不传
parameters.name: body

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to use the Alibaba Cloud ES system credential. Default value: false
parameters.help_zh: 是否使用aliyun es系统凭证。默认false
parameters.name: system

Result.description_en: The response content returned as-is from ES. The structure is determined by the ES API being called
Result.description_zh: ES 原样返回的响应内容，结构由所调用的 ES 接口决定
Result.title_zh: ES 原样返回的响应内容，结构由所调用的 ES 接口决定。
